What you bring to the table - Ability to work in a team and enjoy contact with people - Organisational skills and flexibility - Willingness to work independently and take on responsibilities - Enjoyment of further development in a dynamic company - Quick comprehension and precise way of working - Enjoyment of working with modern technology What we offer you - Annual subscription "update Fitness" - CHF 500 for laptop or tablet - 50% off first mobile plan from Coop Mobile - SBB Half-Fare travelcard or share GA CHF 650 - Many discounts for employees Ladina Maurer HR Vocational Education Choose Your Character - Create Your Future: Shape your future with a suitable apprenticeship.
